changes: Graph-private accepted membership adds a bounded direct bitmap tier for four-coordinate builtin IDs. The previous two-coordinate tier takes precedence; all larger full-width coordinates keep the original ordered tree fallback. Prefixes and word rows grow only when publishing nonzero bits. Entry get/set, accepted counts and every-change undo remain shared with the original dense path.

Full/current captures and nested commit/rollback retain complete PageKeys and original bits. Clones copy all active bits independently. Journaled and ordinary clear release retained direct rows; rollback reconstructs them. No input IDs, output tuples, predicates, score callbacks, settings or event boundaries are changed.

full_receipt.policy: All commands actually executed on unchanged frozen source. Clippy preflight, genuine Cargo all-target no-run prebuild at command jobs8, then standard gate at unchanged normal jobs4 environment; ordinary Cargo/compiler and successful verification reuse, no transplanted job records. No Java qualifier rerun: prior Java evidence remains stale. Actual separately recorded native controls bind the unchanged source and measured artifact; no Java parity credit. Total duration includes preflight/prebuild.

integration_receipt.policy: Exact frozen Rust after actual full native gate. No per-job metadata transplant. Native controls are diagnostic only. Prior Java report retained unchanged and stale; no Java parity claim.

baseline_binding.qualification: actual full native gate and native diagnostic artifact; Java qualification deferred, no parity credit

diagnostic_controls.policy: Four rotating three-second seed7 native pairs per case, runner-a CPU 2,3. Every output independently validated. Exact final source/artifact; no Java timing credit or addition/multiplication into earlier gains.

java_qualification.status: deferred; previous original report unchanged and stale
java_qualification.policy: Current success requires both original same-machine Java/Rust throughput targets, rotating seeds 7/11/23 x10s, CPU 2,3, all 12 independently valid. Quality and feasibility remain separate; no equal-score gate.

tradeoffs: Additional bounded bitmap capacity remains after peak use and is copied by full snapshots. Direct wide rows admit up to 1024 first/third coordinates, 16 second coordinates and 4 word columns (64 final-coordinate bits); worst logical word capacity 128 MiB plus directory and allocator capacity per Membership. Sparse high-prefix keys can cost more memory than tree entries. No total-memory or universal performance claim.

Public APIs, fallback semantics and Send/Sync are unchanged. Original Community provenance and frozen application fixtures/model/declarations/runner/compiler/CPU/PGO/panic/batch settings are unchanged.

profile_evidence.scope: One local Sailing10s seed7 diagnostic of the actual measured artifact, recorded while the gate ran; independently valid, no rebuild or Java timing credit. Reuse this recording.
